description: Metadata for public Our World in Data pages about artificial intelligence on ourworldindata.org. Each stored URL was confirmed with one bounded GET. Chart data, CSV downloads, and Grapher payloads are not stored. A Cloudflare challenge, captcha, HTTP 202, Akamai 403, robots disallow, or off-host redirect stores no row, so entries may be empty. Rows store the title, publisher, canonical URL, date, and rights. Page bodies are not stored. A missing date is unknown. Updated, modified, and copyright years are not publication dates. creative_commons means a stated CC0, CC BY, or CC BY-SA deed without a restricted deed. CC BY-NC, CC BY-ND, CC BY-NC-ND, and CC BY-NC-SA stay unknown. The Public Domain Mark is not CC0. A copyright notice or terms link is not a licence. runner_wired is false.
